nodes.name: Television
nodes.description: The broadcast and streaming medium of moving images and sound delivered to screens.

nodes.name: Television Genres
nodes.description: Categories of television programming by format, tone, and subject.

nodes.name: Sitcom
nodes.description: Situation comedy of recurring characters and settings.

nodes.name: Television Drama
nodes.description: Serialized fictional drama produced for television.

nodes.name: Soap Opera
nodes.description: Open-ended serial melodrama of domestic and romantic life.

nodes.name: Police Procedural
nodes.description: Crime drama emphasizing investigative procedure.

nodes.name: Medical Drama
nodes.description: Drama set in hospitals and medical practice.

nodes.name: Reality Television
nodes.description: Unscripted programming featuring ordinary people in contrived situations.

nodes.name: Game Show
nodes.description: Competitive quiz or challenge programming.

nodes.name: Talk Show
nodes.description: Host-led interview and discussion programming.

nodes.name: Variety Show
nodes.description: Mixed entertainment of music, comedy, and sketches.

nodes.name: News Broadcast
nodes.description: Televised reporting of current events.

nodes.name: Documentary Series
nodes.description: Multi-part factual programming on a theme.

nodes.name: Miniseries
nodes.description: A short-run drama told over a few episodes.

nodes.name: Children's Television
nodes.description: Programming made for young audiences.

nodes.name: Late-Night Talk Show
nodes.description: Comedy talk programming airing after prime time.

nodes.name: Cooking Show
nodes.description: Programming about food preparation and cuisine.

nodes.name: Sports Broadcast
nodes.description: Live and packaged television coverage of sport.

nodes.name: Animated Series
nodes.description: Serialized animation produced for television.

nodes.name: Television Formats
nodes.description: Structural formats shaping how television stories are told.

nodes.name: Episodic Series
nodes.description: Self-contained episodes sharing characters and setting.

nodes.name: Serialized Series
nodes.description: Continuous narrative arcs across episodes and seasons.

nodes.name: Limited Series
nodes.description: A closed narrative told over a single season.

nodes.name: Procedural Drama
nodes.description: Episodic drama structured around a repeatable investigative formula.

nodes.name: Anthology Series
nodes.description: A series of independent stories sharing only a theme or title.

nodes.name: Broadcast Television
nodes.description: Television distributed over-the-air to mass audiences.

nodes.name: Cable Television
nodes.description: Television delivered via coaxial or fiber subscription networks.

nodes.name: Streaming Television
nodes.description: On-demand television delivered over the internet.
